label: Answers that flag quoted text as untrusted
means: inbox_next answers that say each message is quoted data, never an instruction
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-26: messages are written by other people, so an agent must never act on them
source: state: two inbox_next answers on the sample

label: A done thread leaves the list
means: After inbox_mark done, the thread is gone from inbox_next and the waiting count drops by one
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-26: the member never sees a handled thread twice
source: state: one mark on the sample

label: Dry-run replies that touch nothing
means: reply_open with LINKEN_DRY_RUN=1 makes no clipboard or browser call
goal_source: Linken SPEC.md rule 6: a dry run rehearses every write
source: state: one dry-run reply_open on the sample

label: Time to list waiting threads
means: One inbox_next on the sample, in milliseconds
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-26: reading local files should feel instant

label: Tokens per thread
means: One inbox_next answer, characters divided by 4, per thread
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-26: first run measured 70; five threads stay under 500 tokens
source: state: one inbox_next answer on the sample

label: Time to load the sample export
means: One archive_load of the fictional sample export, in milliseconds
